statement: There exist three real plane conics with exactly 136 real tritangent circles. The proof supplies a specific rational triple, obtained by perturbing a triangle degeneration and hill climbing, and certifies its solutions. Hence the global maximum is at least136; the paper’s separate conjecture that136 is maximal is not part of the proved statement and has been disproved.
